frame.comment: The darkest rung in light, so it is where every darkening overlay and the tertiary step come closest.

background.comment: The sheet, dE 3.40 over the frame.

subtle.comment: The card, dE 1.55 over the sheet: near-flat, because a card is found by its hairline.

elevated.comment: Raised is a step DOWN in light: a chip on a white card reads by being greyer than it, dE 3.00. The approved #fafafa sat dE 0.60 off the card, under the 3 raised keeps from it, and is darkened dE 2.42.

hover.comment: The approved overlay, unmoved, and the least alpha that separates a hovered row from every rung by dE 3 (3.04 on the frame, where 0.043 measured 2.97).

pressed.comment: The design record draws no pressed row, so a press is the hover overlay made stronger: the least alpha that separates the two by dE 3 on every rung (3.06 on the frame, where 0.087 measured 2.99).

tertiary.comment: The approved #5a6075, darkened dE 0.71 along lightness: it measured 4.37:1 on a pressed row on the frame.

muted.comment: Decoration only. The approved #8a90a3 measured 2.69:1 on the frame, under the decoration band, and is darkened dE 1.04 to bring it inside (2.80:1).

accent.comment: The approved violet for light, and the primary action's fill. White clears 4.69:1 on it.

accentHover.comment: The approved hover, unmoved: a step darker than the accent (dE 3.92), which takes white from 4.69:1 to 5.55:1.

accentActive.comment: The approved press, unmoved: dE 6.14 past the hover. White clears 7.15:1.

accentInk.comment: The approved #696fdd, darkened dE 9.70: it measured 2.99:1 on a pressed row on the frame, under the 4.5:1 an ink clears as text. Here it clears 4.53:1.

accentSoft.comment: The approved 0.108, raised to 0.125: at 0.108 a selected row on the frame sat only dE 2.40 from a hovered one, under the dE 3 that tells the two apart, and 0.125 is the least alpha that clears it on every rung (3.02 on the frame).

default.comment: The approved #f5f5f5, darkened dE 3.92: it sat dE 0.84 off the sheet and 1.02 off raised, where a hairline has to clear dE 3 to be seen.

strongHover.comment: The default-to-strong step, dE 7.88, taken once more.

control.comment: The neutral mark, #a5a8b1, darkened dE 15.20: it measured 1.66:1 on a pressed row on the frame. The plain border is never a control's edge: it measures 1.19:1 on the card, which is a boundary a reader cannot find.

focus.comment: The accent, unmoved: 3.29:1 at its tightest, on a pressed row on the frame.

success.comment: Done, and still a green. The approved #34c98b, moved dE 13.87 inside its hue family: it measured 1.80:1 as a mark on the frame, under the 3:1 non-text floor.

warning.comment: Needs a person. The approved #ffb300, darkened dE 19.65 to an ochre inside its hue family: it measured 1.52:1 as a mark on the frame.

warningInk.comment: The approved #db9a00, darkened dE 24.95: it measured 1.70:1 on a pressed row on the frame, 1.81:1 on its own soft tint and 1.72:1 on a code chip inside its own callout.

danger.comment: Stopped. The approved #cc2a4a, darkened dE 5.75: it sat dE 7.2 from the success fill under deuteranopia, against the 10 the states keep, and dE 6.9 from the chart green under deuteranopia, against the 8 the reserved red keeps from every series. White clears 6.61:1 on it.

dangerHover.comment: The destructive action under the pointer: a step darker than the danger fill, the least a reader can see (dE 3.02), taking white from 6.61:1 to 7.50:1. The design record draws no hover for it.

dangerInk.comment: The approved #e65656, darkened dE 15.89: it measured 2.52:1 on a pressed row on the frame, 2.49:1 on its own soft tint and 2.36:1 on a code chip inside its own callout.

info.comment: Working. The approved #039cdd, moved dE 6.14 inside its hue family: it measured 2.61:1 as a mark on the frame.

infoInk.comment: The approved #367da1, darkened dE 8.11: it measured 3.19:1 on a pressed row on the frame, 3.42:1 on its own soft tint and 3.24:1 on a code chip inside its own callout.

1.comment: The approved blue, #4381e5, moved dE 5.71 inside its hue family: it sat dE 4.5 from the accent under deuteranopia, under the 8 no hue may come within.

2.comment: The approved orange, #ed810c, moved dE 9.59 inside its hue family: it measured 2.29:1 as a mark on the frame.

3.comment: The approved green, #2f9d4c, moved dE 5.75 inside its hue family, toward aqua: it measured 2.94:1 as a mark on the frame, sat dE 5.6 from the yellow under protanopia and 8.1 under deuteranopia, against the 9 neighbouring series keep, and dE 7.9 from the danger fill under deuteranopia, against the 8 the reserved red keeps.

4.comment: The approved yellow, #edb302, darkened dE 17.33 to an ochre: it measured 1.61:1 as a mark on the frame, and a yellow dark enough to be seen on a light page is an ochre. It sits beside the warning fill, both yellows darkened onto the same floor, and a series is only ever read inside a figure that names it.

other.comment: The approved neutral mark, #a5a8b1, darkened dE 11.05: it measured 2.01:1 as a mark on the frame.

sheet.comment: The xl step turned onto the inline axis. The alphas are the light palette's own: a 0.4 black cast 8px into a near-white page is a smear rather than an edge.

hairline.comment: On a light ground a panel is lifted by its shadow. The top-edge rim light is a dark-palette device and would be invisible here.
